title: Site Retention Relief on Pre-Supply C&I Damages
content:
For Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts, the damages of a termination before supply are reduced by its site retention relief: when the Beacon Ridge small business electricity agreement, under Small Business Electricity Supply, on the same premise is active with no drop requested, the relief is 0.25 of the damages; when that agreement is in drop pending status with a drop requested, the relief is 0.10; any other case gives no relief. The relief removes its share from the damages amount as it stands before rounding, and only that result is rounded to the cent and compared with the minimum fee.

The records read are the Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on the premise of the terminated C&I contract: its status and its drop requested date, a blank drop requested date meaning that no drop has been requested.

| Small business agreement status | Drop requested date | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| active | blank | 0.25 (25%) |
| active | present | none |
| drop pending | present | 0.10 (10%) |
| drop pending | blank | none |
| any other status | either | none |
| no small business agreement on the premise | none | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A damages amount of 3000.01 before rounding, with an active small business agreement and no drop requested, loses 25% of itself: 3000.01 multiplied by 0.75 is 2250.0075, which on this relief alone rounds to $2250.01 and is then compared with the minimum fee.
